mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run_loop (run_id, loop_index, main_agent_stage, status, record_ref, record_version, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{loopIndex}, #{mainAgentStage}, #{status}, #{recordRef}, #{recordVersion}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE main_agent_stage = VALUES(main_agent_stage), status = VALUES(status), record_ref = VALUES(record_ref), record_version = VALUES(record_version), started_at = VALUES(started_at), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, loop_index, main_agent_stage, status, record_ref, record_version, started_at, completed_at FROM agent_run_loop WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND loop_index = #{loopIndex}
SELECT id, run_id, loop_index, main_agent_stage, status, record_ref, record_version, started_at, completed_at FROM agent_run_loop WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY loop_index ASC
